0.5.1 fixes settings search in current Obsidian while keeping compatibility with Obsidian 1.5.
This personal fork supports Linux desktop. macOS and mobile are out of scope, and this release is
marked desktop-only. Windows supplies additional development checks. The fork is not in
Obsidian's community plugin directory; install it by hand.

## Install

1. Download `viell-html-page-viewer-0.5.1.zip` below.
2. Unzip it into your vault's `.obsidian/plugins/` folder, so that
   `.obsidian/plugins/viell-html-page-viewer/` holds `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css`,
   replacing those of an earlier version.
3. In Obsidian, open **Settings → Community plugins**. If upstream's **HTML Page Viewer** is
   installed, turn it off: both plugins open `.html` and `.htm` files. Then turn on **HTML Page
   Viewer (viell)**, or turn it off and on again if it was on; if it is not listed yet, reload the
   list of installed plugins.

To go back, install 0.5.0 the same way. Settings are kept. The plugin never changes your notes or
pages.

## Fixed

- All five viewer settings appear in the global settings search on Obsidian 1.13 and later.
  Their names, defaults, saving, and immediate effects stay the same. Older Obsidian versions
  keep the same settings tab.

## Known limits

- With scripts on, the find bar searches only the source, split-view scrolling is independent,
  and links work as in a browser frame. Local files load only with **Local files with scripts
  on**, within its 8 MB per-file and 32 MB per-page limits. Files loaded by scripts themselves,
  imported modules, and pages in frames do not load.
- Stylesheets from the web do not apply, apart from Google Fonts. Local stylesheets must end in
  `.css`.
- A link to a part of another page opens that page at its top.

## Testing

Tested in Linux Obsidian 1.5.3 and 1.14.5, including the settings tab, saving and applying changes,
global settings search where available, page rendering, links, find, split view, and the synthetic
archive corpus compared with the frozen prototype. Build and unit checks also run on Windows.
`SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums of the files below.
